4.2.1.v: The affix अण् already ordained -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]], comes after the name of a colour in the sense of 'coloured thereby'.
4.2.1.e: To express the meaning of 'colored by', an appropriate प्रत्यय gets added to the तृतीयासमर्थ word representing the name of the color.
4.2.1.sa: तृतीयासमर्थात् रागवाचिनः सुबन्तात् 'रक्तम्' अस्मिन् अर्थे अण् प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.1.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.2.v: The affix ठक् comes, in the sense of coloured thereby after the words 1. लाक्षा 2. रोचना 3. शकल 4. कर्दमा (which being names of colours, are in the Instrumental -3rd case in a sentence).
4.2.2.e: For the word  लाक्षा, रोचना, शकल and कर्दम, ठक्-प्रत्ययः is used to indicate the meaning of 'colored by'.
4.2.2.sa: 'रक्तम् रागात्' अस्मिन् अर्थे लाक्षा, रोचना, शकल, तथा कर्दम - एतेभ्यः तृतीयासमर्थेभ्यः शब्देभ्यः ठक्-प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
4.2.2.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.3.v: The affix अण् already ordained -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]], comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction which is the name of a lunar mansion, to signify a time connected with the asterism.
4.2.3.e: To indicate the meaning of 'time occupied by a certain नक्षत्र', an appropriateतद्धित प्रत्यय can be attached to the word in तृतीया विभक्ति  that indicates name of the नक्षत्र.
4.2.3.sa: नक्षत्रवाचिनः तृतीयासमर्थात् 'युक्तः कालः' अस्मिन् अर्थे अण् तद्धितप्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
4.2.3.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.4.v: The affix above ordained is elided by लुप् when there is no specification.
4.2.4.e: To indicate the meaning of 'time occupied by a certain नक्षत्र', an appropriate तद्धित प्रत्यय which  gets attached to the word in तृतीया विभक्ति undergoes a लुप् if the time being indicated does not have a particular name.
4.2.4.sa: नक्षत्रवाचिनः तृतीयासमर्थात् 'युक्तः कालः' अस्मिन् अर्थे प्रयुक्तस्य तद्धितप्रत्ययस्य अविशेष-कालस्य निर्देशे लुप् भवति ।
4.2.4.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.5.v: The affix above ordained is elided by लुप् after the words 1. श्रवण and 2. अश्वथ when the whole word so formed is an appellation and there is specification of time.
4.2.5.sa: 'युक्तः कालः' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'श्रवण' तथा 'अश्वत्थ' शब्दाभ्याम् प्रयुक्तस्य तद्धितप्रत्ययस्य  संज्ञायाः निर्देशे लुप् भवति ।

4.2.6.v: The affix छ comes after the द्वन्द compound of the names of lunar mansions, when it is in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction, to signify time connected with the asterism whether there be a specification or not.
4.2.6.e: To indicate the meaning of 'time occupied by a certain  नक्षत्र', छ प्रत्यय can be attached to the word in तृतीया विभक्ति that indicates name of a नक्षत्रद्वन्द्व.
4.2.6.sa: 'युक्तः कालः' अस्मिन् अर्थे नक्षत्रद्वन्द्वात् विशेषकालं अविशेषकालं च निर्देशयितुम् छ-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.6.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.7.v: The affix अण् -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] comes after a word in construction in the Instrumental -3rd case, in the sense of seen - the thing seen by the one whose name is in the Instrumental -3rd case, being the साम वेद।
4.2.7.e: To indicate the name of a साम using its visionary, an appropriate तद्धितप्रत्यय gets attached to the तृतीयासमर्थ name of the visionary.
4.2.7.sa: येन साम दृष्टम् तस्मात् तृतीयासमर्थात् 'साम' निर्देशयितुमण् प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.7.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.8.v: The affix ढक् comes in the sense of साम वेद seen after the word कलि being in the Instrumental -3rd case.
4.2.8.e: The word कलि gets the तद्धितप्रत्यय 'ढक्' in the meaning of 'दृष्टं साम'.
4.2.8.sa: 'दृष्टं साम' अस्मिन् अर्थे तृतीयासमर्थात् कलि-शब्दात् ढक्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.8.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.9.v: The affixes ड्यत् and ड्य come in the sense of the साम वेद seen after the word वामदेव , being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction.
4.2.9.e: The word वामदेव gets the प्रत्ययs ड्यत् and ड्य in the meaning of  'तेन दृष्टं साम'.
4.2.9.sa: 'दृष्टं साम' अस्मिन् अर्थे तृतीयासमर्थात्  वामदेव-शब्दात् 'ड्यत्' तथा 'ड्य' प्रत्ययौ भवतः
4.2.9.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.10.v: The affix अण् comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'surrounded' the thing so surrounded being 'a chariot'.
4.2.10.e: To represent a रथ using a material used to cover it completely, an appropriate तद्धितप्रत्यय can be attached to the तृतीयासमर्थ indicating the covering entity.
4.2.10.sa: तृतीयासमर्थात् 'परिवृतः' इत्यस्मिन् अर्थे रथं निर्देशयितुमण् प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.10.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.11.v: The affix इनि comes after the word पाण्डुकम्बल etc. being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'surrounded' the thing so surrounded being 'a chariot'.
4.2.11.e: The word पाण्डुकम्बल gets the प्रत्यय 'इनि' in the meaning of 'परिवृतो रथः'.
4.2.11.sa: 'पाण्डुकम्बल'शब्दात् 'परिवृतः' अस्मिन् अर्थे रथं निर्देशयितुम् इनि प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.11.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.12.v: The affix अञ् comes after the words द्वैप and वैयाघ्र being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'surrounded' the thing so surrounded being 'a chariot'.
4.2.12.e: The words द्वैप  and वैयाघ्र get the प्रत्यय अञ् in the meaning of 'परिवृतो रथः'
4.2.12.sa: द्वैपशब्दात् वैयाघ्रशब्दात् च 'परिवृतः' अस्मिन् अर्थे रथं निर्देशयितुम् 'अञ्' प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.12.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.13.v: The word कौमार is irregularly formed by adding the affix अण् when meaning 'virginity'.

4.2.14.v: The affix अञ् already ordained -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]], comes in the sense of 'placed thereon' after words denoting vessels when such words are in the Locative -7th case in construction.
4.2.14.e: When a food item is taken out in certain vessel, the food item can be represented by attaching an appropriate तद्धितप्रत्यय to the name of the vessel occurring in the सप्तमी विभक्ति.
4.2.14.sa: सप्तमीसमर्थात् अमत्रवाचिनः शब्दात् 'उद्धृतम्' इत्यस्मिन् अर्थे अण् प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.14.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.15.v: The affix अञ् already ordained -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]], comes after the word स्थण्डिल being in the Locative -7th case in construction in the sense of 'a sleeper thereon' and the whole word so formed denotes 'a person performing a vow'.
4.2.15.sa: 'स्थण्डिल'शब्दात् 'यः व्रतस्य उद्देशेन शयनं करोति' तस्य निर्देशं कर्तुमण् प्रत्ययः भवति  ।

4.2.16.v: The affix अण् comes after a word ending in the Locative -7th case to denote 'what is prepared therein' -if that which is so prepared be 'granular food'.
4.2.16.e: To indicate a food item using the vessel or the medium used for its processing / culturing / preparation, an appropriate तद्धितप्रत्यय can be used with the word in the सप्तमी विभक्ति indicating the name of the vessel or the medium.
4.2.16.sa: सप्तमीसमर्थशब्दात् 'संस्कृतम्' इत्यस्मिन् अर्थे भक्षं निर्देशयितुमण् प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.16.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.17.v: The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'prepared food' after the words शूल and उखा ending in the Locative -7th case.
4.2.17.e: The words शूल and उखा get the प्रत्यय यत् in the meaning of संस्कृतं भक्षाः.
4.2.17.sa: शूलशब्दात् उखाशब्दात् च 'संस्कृतं भक्षाः' इत्यस्मिन् अर्थे यत्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.17.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.18.e: The word दधि gets the प्रत्यय ठक् in the meaning of संस्कृतं भक्षाः.
4.2.18.sa: दधिशब्दात् 'संस्कृतं भक्षाः' इत्यस्मिन् अर्थे ठक् -प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.18.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.19.v: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'prepared food', optionally after the word उदश्वित ending in the Locative -7th case.
4.2.19.e: The word  उदश्वित् gets the प्रत्यय ठक्  optionally the meaning of संस्कृतं भक्षाः.
4.2.19.sa: 'संस्कृतम् भक्षाः' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'उदश्वित्' शब्दात् 'ठक्' तथा 'अण्' प्रत्ययौ भवतः ।
4.2.19.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.20.v: The affix ढञ् comes in the sense of 'prepared food' after the word दधि ending in the Locative -7th case.
4.2.20.e: The word क्षीर gets the प्रत्यय ढञ् in the meaning of 'संस्कृतं भक्षाः'
4.2.20.sa: 'संस्कृतं भक्षाः' अस्मिन् अर्थे क्षीर-शब्दात् ढञ्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.20.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.21.v: The affix अण् comes after the name of a full-moon-night to denote the division of time in which the night falls.
4.2.21.e: To indicate the name of a month, fortnight or a year based on the name of the full-moon-day falling in it, the प्रथमासमर्थ name of the full moon day gets the appropriate तद्धितप्रत्यय.
4.2.21.sa: पौर्णमास्याः यत् प्रथमासमर्थं नाम, तस्मात् शब्दात् 'अस्मिन्' इत्यर्थे मासस्य, अर्धमासस्य, संवत्सरस्य वा निर्देशं कर्तुमण् प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.21.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.22.v: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of Locative -7th case after the words आग्रहायणी and अश्वत्थ ending in the 1st - Nominative Case-affix in construction and being the name of a full-moon night.
4.2.22.e: The words आग्रहायण and अश्वत्थ get the प्रत्यय ठक् in the meaning of 'सा अस्मिन् पौर्णमासी इति संज्ञायाम्'.
4.2.22.sa: आग्रहायणी-शब्दात् तथा अश्वत्थ-शब्दात् 'सा अस्मिन् पौर्णमासी इति संज्ञायाम्' अस्मिन् अर्थे ठक् प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.22.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.23.v: The affix ढक् optionally comes after the words 1. फाल्गुनी 2. कार्त्तिकी and 3. चैत्री being the names of full-moon nights, the whole word so formed being a Name denoting a division of time (a month, a fortnight or a year) in which the moon is full.
4.2.23.e: The words फाल्गुनी, श्रवणा, कार्त्तिकी and चैत्री optionally get the प्रत्यय ठक् in the meaning of  'सा अस्मिन् पौर्णमासी इति संज्ञायाम्'.
4.2.23.sa: 'सा अस्मिन् पौर्णमासी इति संज्ञायाम्' अस्मिन् अर्थे  फाल्गुनी-श्रवणा-कार्त्तिकी-चैत्रीभ्यः ठक् तथा अण् प्रत्ययौ भवतः ।
4.2.23.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.24.v: The affix अण् -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]], is added to the name of a deity when something is to be spoken of as his.
4.2.24.e: To indicate an entity by referring to its god, an appropriate तद्धित प्रत्यय can be attached to the प्रथमासमर्थ word representing the name of the god.
4.2.24.sa: प्रथमासमर्थात् देवतावाची-शब्दात् 'अस्य' इत्यस्मिन् अर्थे अण् प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.24.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.25.v: The short इ is the substitute of the final अ of क when the affix is added.
4.2.25.e: In the meaning of 'सा अस्य देवता', the word 'क' gets the 'इत्' आदेश.
4.2.25.sa: 'सा अस्य देवता' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'क' शब्दस्य 'इत्' आदेशः भवति ।
4.2.25.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.26.v: The affix घन् comes in the sense of 'that its deity' after the word शुक्र।
4.2.26.e: The word शुक्र gets the घन् प्रत्यय in the meaning of 'सा अस्य देवता'.
4.2.26.sa: 'सा अस्य देवता' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'शुक्र'शब्दात् 'घन्' प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.26.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.27.v: The affix घ comes after the words 1. अपोनप्तृ and 2. अपन्नप्तृ in the sense of 'that its deity'.
4.2.27.e: The words 'अपोनप्तात्' and 'अपान्नप्तात्'   get the घ प्रत्यय in the meaning of  सा अस्य देवता, and they also get converted to 'अपोनप्तृ' and 'अपान्नप्तृ' respectively.
4.2.27.sa: 'सा अस्य देवता' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'अपोनप्तृ' तथा 'अपान्नप्तृ' शब्दाभ्याम् 'घ'-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.27.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.28.v: Also छ is added to the words 1. अपोनप्तृ and 2. अपन्नप्तृ in the sense of 'that its deity'.
4.2.28.e: The words 'अपोनप्तात्' and 'अपान्नप्तात्'   get the छ-प्रत्यय in the meaning of  सा अस्य देवता, and they also get converted to 'अपोनप्तृ' and 'अपान्नप्तृ' respectively.
4.2.28.sa: 'सा अस्य देवता' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'अपोनप्तृ' तथा 'अपान्नप्तृ' शब्दाभ्याम् 'छ'-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.28.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.29.v: The affixes घ and अण् and छ come after the name महेन्द्र in the sense of 'this its deity'.
4.2.29.e: The word 'महेन्द्र' gets the प्रत्ययाः घ, छ, and अण् in the meaning of  'सा अस्य देवता'.
4.2.29.sa: महेन्द्र-शब्दात् 'सा अस्य देवता' अस्मिन् अर्थे घ-प्रत्ययः, छ-प्रत्ययः, अण्-प्रत्ययः च भवन्ति ।
4.2.29.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.30.v: The affix ट्यण् comes after the name सोम in the sense of 'this its deity'.
4.2.30.e: The word सोम gets the प्रत्यय 'ट्यण्' in the meaning of 'सा अस्य देवता'.
4.2.30.sa: 'सा अस्य देवता' अस्मिन् अर्थे सोम-शब्दात् ट्यण्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.30.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.31.v: The affix यत् comes after the names 1. वायु 2. ऋतु 3. पितृ and 4. उषस् in the sense of 'this its deity'.
4.2.31.e: The words 'वायु', 'ऋतु', 'पितृ' and 'उषस्' get the प्रत्यय यत् in the meaning of  'सा अस्य देवता'.
4.2.31.sa: 'सा अस्य देवता' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'वायु', 'ऋतु', 'पितृ' तथा 'उषस्' शब्दात् यत् प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.31.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.32.v: The affix छ also comes in the sense of 'this its deity' after the names 1. द्यावा 2. पृथिवी 3. शुनासीर 4. मरुत्वद् 5. अग्निषोम 6. वास्तोष्पति 7. गृहमेधा।
4.2.32.e: The words द्यावापृथिवी, शुनासीर, मरुत्वत्, अग्नीषोम, वास्तोष्पति and गृहमेध get the यत् and the छ प्रत्यय in the meaning of 'सा अस्य देवता'.
4.2.32.sa: 'सा अस्य देवता' अस्मिन् अर्थे द्यावापृथिवी, शुनासीर, मरुत्वत्, अग्नीषोम, वास्तोष्पति, गृहमेध - एतेभ्यः शब्देभ्यः यत्-प्रत्ययः छ-प्रत्ययः च विधीयते ।
4.2.32.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.33.v: The affix ढक् comes in the sense of 'this its deity' after the name अग्नि।
4.2.33.e: The word अग्नि gets the प्रत्यय ढक् in the meaning of 'सा अस्य देवता'.
4.2.33.sa: 'सा अस्य देवता' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'अग्नि'शब्दात् ढक्-प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
4.2.33.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.34.v: After the words expressive of time, the affixes denoting 'who stays there' -- कालाट्ठञ् [[4.3.11]] to तत्र भवः [[4.3.53]], come also in the sense of 'this its deity'.
4.2.34.e: For the कालवाची words, the same प्रत्यय that is provided for the meaning 'तत्र भवः' comes for the meaning 'सा अस्य देवता'  as well.
4.2.34.sa: 'तत्र भव' अस्मिन् अर्थे कालवाचिभ्यः प्रातिपदिकेभ्यः ये प्रत्ययाः विधीयन्ते, ते एव 'सा अस्य देवता' अस्मिन् अर्थे अपि विधीयन्ते ।
4.2.34.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.35.v: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'this its deity' after the words 1. महाराज and 2. प्रोष्ठपद।
4.2.35.e: The words 'महाराज' and 'प्रोष्ठपद' get the प्रत्यय ठञ् in the meaning of 'सा अस्य देवता'.
4.2.35.sa: 'सा अस्य देवता' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'महाराज' शब्दात् तथा 'प्रोष्ठपद' शब्दात् ठञ् प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.35.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.36.v: The words 1. पितृव्य 'a father's brother' 2. मातुल 'a mother's brother' 3. मातामह 'a mother's father' 4. पितामह 'a father's father' are irregularly formed.
4.2.36.e: The words पितृव्य, मातुल, मातामह and  पितामह are given 'readymade' (that is, without any प्रक्रिया).
4.2.36.sa: पितृव्य, मातुल, मातामह,पितामह - एते शब्दाः निपात्यन्ते ।
4.2.36.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.37.v: An affix is added to a word when the sense is 'a collection thereof'.
4.2.37.e: To indicate the meaning of 'collection / group', a षष्ठीसमर्थ word gets an appropriate तद्धितप्रत्यय.
4.2.37.sa: षष्ठीसमर्थात् शब्दात् समूहस्य निर्देशं कर्तुमण् प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.37.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.38.v: The affix अण् comes the sense is 'a collection thereof' after the words भिक्षा etc.
4.2.38.sa: भिक्षादिगणस्य शब्दानां विषये 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे अण्-प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
4.2.38.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.39.v: The affix वुञ् comes the sense is 'a collection thereof' after a word denoting a गोत्र (Patronymic) and after 1. उक्ष 2. उष्ट्र 3. उरभ्र 4. राजन 5. राजन्य 6. राजपुत्र 7. वत्स 8. मनुष्य and 9. अज।
4.2.39.e: For the words that indicate a गोत्र, and for the words in this list - उक्षन्, उष्ट्र, उरभ्र, राजन्, राजन्य, राजपुत्र, वत्स, मनुष्य,  अज - The वुञ् प्रत्यय is added to indicate the meaning of तस्य समूहः.
4.2.39.sa: गोत्रवाचिनः शब्दाः, तथा  उक्षन्, उष्ट्र, उरभ्र, राजन्, राजन्य, राजपुत्र, वत्स, मनुष्य,  अज - एतेभ्यः शब्देभ्यः 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे वुञ्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.39.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.40.v: The affixes यञ् and वुञ् come after the word केदार in the sense of 'collection thereof'.
4.2.40.sa: 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे केदार-शब्दात् यञ् तथा वुञ् प्रत्ययौ भवतः ।
4.2.40.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.41.v: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'collection thereof' after the word केदार and also after the word कवचिन ।
4.2.41.e: The words केदार and कवचिन् get the ठञ् प्रत्यय in the meaning of 'तस्य समूहः'.
4.2.41.sa: 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे केदार-शब्दात् कवचिन्-शब्दात् च 'ठञ्' प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.41.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.42.v: The affix यन् is added in the sense of 'collection thereof' after the words 1. ब्राह्मण 2. माणव and वाडव ।
4.2.42.e: The words ब्राह्मण, माणव, वाडव get the 'यन्' प्रत्यय in the meaning of 'तस्य समूहः'.
4.2.42.sa: 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'ब्राह्मण', 'माणव', 'वाडव' शब्देभ्यः यन्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.42.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.43.v: The affix तल् comes in the sense of 'collection thereof' after the words 1. ग्राम 2. जन 3. बन्धु and 4. सहाय।
4.2.43.e: The words ग्राम, जन, बन्धु, सहाय get the प्रत्यय तल् to express the meaning of 'तस्य समूहः'
4.2.43.sa: 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे ग्राम, जन, बन्धु, सहाय - एतेभ्यः शब्देभ्यः 'तल्' प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
4.2.43.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.44.v: The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'collection thereof' after the words having अनुदात्त on the first syllable.
4.2.44.e: For the words whose first vowel is अनुदात्त, the अञ् प्रत्यय is added in the meaning of 'तस्य समूहः'.
4.2.44.sa: अनुदात्तादिशब्दात् 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे अञ्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.44.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.45.v: The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'collection thereof' after the words खण्डिक etc.
4.2.45.e: The words of the खण्डिकादिगण get अञ् प्रत्यय to indicate the meaning of 'तस्य समूहः'
4.2.45.sa: 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे खण्डिकादिगणे विद्यमानानां शब्दानां विषये अञ्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.45.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.46.v: After the name of a Vedic School, the affixes which denote the rule of that school, also come in the sense of 'collection thereof'.
4.2.46.e: For the words that represent the names of stanzas of a poem, the प्रत्ययाः that are applicable in the meaning given by the वार्त्तिक 'चरणात् धर्माम्नानयोः इष्यते' should also be used in the meaning of  'तस्य समूहः' as well.
4.2.46.sa: चरणवाचिभ्यः (= पद्यपङ्क्तिवाचिभ्यः ) प्रातिपदिकेभ्यः 'चरणात् धर्माम्नानयोः इष्यते' अनेन वार्त्तिकेन उक्ताः प्रत्ययाः 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे अपि विधीयन्ते ।
4.2.46.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.47.v: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'collection thereof' after the names of things without consciousness and after 1. हस्ति and 2. धेनु।
4.2.47.e: For the words that represent non-living entities, and also for the words हस्तिन् and धेनु, the प्रत्यय ठक् is used to indicate the meaning of 'तस्य समूहः'.
4.2.47.sa: अचित्तवाचिभ्यः शब्देभ्यः, 'हस्ति'शब्दात् तथा 'धेनु'शब्दात् 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे ठक्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.47.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.48.v: The affixes यञ् and छ come optionally in the sense of 'collection thereof' after the words 1. केश and 2. अश्व , respectively.
4.2.48.e: The word केश optionally gets the प्रत्यय यञ् to indicate the meaning of 'तस्य समूहः'. The word अश्व optionally gets the प्रत्यय छ to indicate the meaning of 'तस्य समूहः'
4.2.48.sa: 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे केशशब्दात् यञ्-प्रत्ययः , तथा अश्वशब्दात् छ-प्रत्ययः विकल्पेन भवति ।
4.2.48.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.49.v: The affix य comes in the sense of 'collection thereof' after the words पाश etc.
4.2.49.e: The words of पाशादिगण get the प्रत्यय 'य' in the meaning of 'तस्य समूहः'
4.2.49.sa: पाशादिगणस्य शब्दानां विषये 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे य-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.49.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.50.v: The affix य comes in the sense of 'collection thereof' after the words 1. खल 2 गो and 3. रथ।
4.2.50.e: The words खल, गो and रथ get the प्रत्यय  'य' to indicate the meaning of 'तस्य समूहः'.
4.2.50.sa: 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे 'खल', 'गो', तथा 'रथ' - एतेभ्यः शब्देभ्यः य-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.50.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.51.v: The affixes इनि , त्र and कट्यष्यच् come in the sense of 'collection thereof', respectively after the words 1. खल 2 गो and 3. रथ।
4.2.51.e: The words खल, गो and रथ respectively get the प्रत्ययाः - इनि, त्र, कट्यच् to indicate the meaning of 'तस्य समूहः'.
4.2.51.sa: 'तस्य समूहः' अस्मिन् अर्थे खल-शब्दात् इनि-प्रत्ययः भवति, गो-शब्दात् त्र-प्रत्ययः भवति, तथा रथ-शब्दात् कट्यच्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.51.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.52.v: The affix अण् -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]], comes after a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction in the sense of 'any body'sūtras sphere', if a country is indicated by such sphere.
4.2.52.e: When the word विषय is used to indicate the meaning of देश (ग्रामसमुदाय), then the षष्ठीसमर्थ with which the word विषय is associated gets an appropriate तद्धितप्रत्यय.
4.2.52.sa: षष्ठीसमर्थात् 'विषय' शब्दे परे देशस्य निर्देशं कर्तुम् यथाविहितः तद्धितप्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.52.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.53.v: The affix वुञ् comes after the words राजन्य etc. in the same sense.
4.2.53.e: The words of the राजन्यादिगण get the प्रत्यय 'वुञ्' in the meaning of 'विषयः देशे'.
4.2.53.sa: 'तस्य विषयः देशे' अस्मिन् अर्थे राजन्यादिगणस्य शब्देभ्यः वुञ्-प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
4.2.53.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.54.v: The affixes विधल् and भक्तल् come respectively after the words बहौरिकि and ऐषुकारि etc. in the sense of 'sphere of country'.
4.2.54.e:
The words of the भौरिक्यादिगण get the प्रत्यय 'विधल्' to indicate the meaning of  'विषयः देशे'. 
The words of the ऐषुकार्यादिगण get the प्रत्यय 'भक्तल्' to indicate the meaning of  'विषयः देशे'.
4.2.54.sa: 'तस्य विषयः देशे' अस्मिन् अर्थे भौरिक्यादिगणस्य शब्देभ्यः विधल्-प्रत्ययः भवति, तथा ऐषुकार्यादि-गणस्य शब्देभ्यः भक्तल्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.54.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.55.v: The affix अण् is added to the names of Meters, indicates a प्रगाथ beginning therewith.
4.2.55.e: To indicate a प्रगाथ using the छन्द of the first stanza of that प्रगाथ, an appropriate तद्धितप्रत्यय can be attached to the प्रथमासमर्थ representing the name of the छन्द.
4.2.55.sa: प्रथमासमर्थ-छन्दवाचिभ्यः प्रातिपदिकेभ्यः 'प्रगाथस्य आदिः' अस्मिन् अर्थे यथाविहितः प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.55.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.56.v: The affix अण् -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] when it is added to a word which denotes either the object of a battle or the warrior of a battle fought for that object or by that warrior as a leader.
4.2.56.e: To indicate a battle using the purpose or the participants of that battle, an appropriate तद्धितप्रत्यय can be attached to the word in the प्रथमा विभक्ति which represents the purpose or the participants of the battle.
4.2.56.sa: प्रथमासमर्थात् प्रयोजनवाचिनः / योद्धावाचिनः शब्दात् सङ्ग्रामस्य निर्देशं कर्तुम् यथाविहितः प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.56.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.57.v: The affix ण to the name of a weapon indicates a game played with that weapon.
4.2.57.e: To indicate a sport using an entity used for hitting in that sport, an appropriate तद्धितप्रत्यय gets attached to the प्रथमासमर्थ word indicating the name of the entity used for hitting.
4.2.57.sa: प्रथमासमर्थात् प्रहरणवाचिनः शब्दात् क्रीडां द्योतयितुम् ण-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.57.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.58.v: The affix ञ added to a noun of action ending in the affix घञ् denotes an action occurring in that.

4.2.59.v: The affix अण् -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण् [[4.1.83]] comes after a word denoting 'some subject of study' in the sense of 'who has studied that or who understands that'.

4.2.60.v: The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'one who studies or one who understands' after the name of a sacrifice after उक्थ etc. and after a stem ending with the word सूत्र।

4.2.61.v: The affix वुन् comes in the sense of 'who studies or who knows' after the words क्रम etc.

4.2.62.v: The affix इनि comes in the sense of 'who studies or who knows' after the word अनुब्राह्मण।

4.2.63.v: The affix ठक् comes in the sense of 'who studies or who knows' after the words वसन्त etc.

4.2.64.v: After the title of a work which is named after the Announcer thereof the affixes denoting 'who studies or who knows that' are elided by लुक् ।

4.2.65.v: The affix denoting denoting 'who studies or who knows that' is elided by लुक् after the title of a sūtra work having क् as penultimate.

4.2.66.v: The affixes denoting the Announcer when added to छन्दस् (Vedas) and the ब्राह्मण-sūtras express this relation only.

4.2.67.v: (An affix is placed after a word expressive of anything) in the sense of '- that thing is in this' - the place taking a name therefrom.
4.2.67.e: To indicate the name of a country by referring to the entities present in that country, an appropriate तद्धित प्रत्यय gets attached to the word in प्रथमाविभक्ति representing the name of that entity.
4.2.67.sa: प्रथमासमर्थात् 'तत् अस्मिन् देशे अस्ति' इत्यर्थे देशस्य नाम्नः निर्देशं कर्तुम् यथाविहितः प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.67.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.68.v: After a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction an affix is added in the sense of 'completed by him' when the whole word so formed is the name of a country.
4.2.68.e: To indicate the name of a country by referring to its creator, an appropriate तद्धित प्रत्यय gets attached to the word in तृतीयाविभक्ति representing the name of the creator.
4.2.68.sa: तृतीयासमर्थात्  'तेन निर्वृत्तम्'  इत्यर्थे देशस्य नाम्नः निर्देशं कर्तुम् यथाविहितः प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.68.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.69.v: After a word in the Genitive -6th-Case in construction an affix is added in the sense of 'his dwelling-place' the whole word expressing the name of a country.
4.2.69.e: To indicate the name of a country by referring to its residents, an appropriate तद्धित प्रत्यय gets attached to the word in षष्ठीविभक्ति representing the name of the residents.
4.2.69.sa: षष्ठीसमर्थात्  'तस्य निवासः' अस्मिन् अर्थे देशस्य नाम्नः निर्देशं कर्तुम् यथाविहितः प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.69.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.70.v: And lastly a place is named after whatever is found near it.
4.2.70.e: To indicate the name of a country by referring to the another country that is near it, an appropriate तद्धित प्रत्यय gets attached to the word in षष्ठीविभक्ति representing the name of the country that is nearby.
4.2.70.sa: षष्ठीसमर्थात् 'अस्य निकटः देशः' अस्मिन् अर्थे देशस्य नाम्नः निर्देशं कर्तुम् यथाविहितः प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.70.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.71.v: The affix अञ् comes after a stem ending in a उ or ऊ (in the four-fold senses given above).
4.2.71.e: The उवर्णान्त प्रातिपदिकs get the प्रत्यय अञ् in the context of चतुरर्थाः.
4.2.71.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.72.v: The affix अञ् comes in the quadruple sense after a word which ends in the affix मतुप् and whose stem is polysyllabic.
4.2.72.e: For the word that ends in a मतुप्-प्रत्यय and has three or more स्वराः in the अङ्ग to which the  मतुप्-प्रत्यय is attached, the अञ् प्रत्यय is used in the context of चतुरर्थाः.
4.2.72.sa: यस्य मतुप्-प्रत्ययान्त-शब्दस्य अङ्गम् 'बह्वच्' अस्ति, तस्मात् चतुरर्थेषु अञ्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.72.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.73.v: The affix अञ् comes in the quadruple sense after a polysyllabic प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) when 'a well' is to be designated.
4.2.73.e: In the context of चतुरर्थाः, to indicate the name of a well by referring to a word that has three or more स्वराः , अञ् प्रत्यय is used.
4.2.73.sa: यः शब्दः 'बह्वच्' अस्ति, तस्मात् कूपस्य निर्देशं कर्तुम् चतुरर्थेषु अञ्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.73.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.74.v: The affix अञ् comes in the quadruple sense after any polysyllabic प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) in denoting 'a well' situated on the Northern bank of the river विपाश।
4.2.74.e: In the context of चतुरर्थाः, to indicate the name of a well by referring to a word having one or two स्वराः,  अञ् प्रत्यय is used if the well exists in the northern region of the river विपाश् .
4.2.74.sa: 'विपाश्' नद्याः उत्तरदिशि ये कूपाः सन्ति, तेषाम् नाम्नः चतुरर्थेषु निर्देशं कर्तुमञ्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.74.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.75.v: The affix अण् comes after the words संकल etc. in the above 4-fold sense.
4.2.75.e: In the context of चतुरर्थाः, the words belonging to the सङ्कलादिगण get the अञ् प्रत्यय.
4.2.75.sa: सङ्कलादिगणस्य शब्देभ्यः चतुरर्थेषु अञ् प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.75.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.76.v: So also when the palace is situated in the lands of the सौवीर or साल्व or of the Eatern People and the word in these cases is always feminine.
4.2.76.e: In the context of  चतुरर्थाः,  To indicate the feminine name of a country in the सौवीर region, शाल्व region or eastern region, the अञ् प्रत्यय  is used.
4.2.76.sa: सौवीरे विद्यमानस्य देशस्य, साल्वे विद्यमानस्य देशस्य, तथा पूर्वदिशि विद्यमानस्य देशस्य चतुरर्थेषु स्त्रीलिङ्गे अभिधानम् कर्तव्यमस्ति चेत् अञ्-प्रत्ययः विधीयते ।
4.2.76.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.77.v: The affix अञ् comes after the words सुवास्तु etc. in the 4-fold sense.
4.2.77.e: In the context of चतुरर्थाः,  the words of the सुवास्तुगण get the अण्  प्रत्यय.
4.2.77.sa: सुवास्तुगणस्य शब्देभ्यः चतुरर्थेषु अण्  प्रत्ययः भवति ।
4.2.77.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.78.v: The affix अण् comes after राणो in the 4-fold sense.
4.2.78.e: In the context of चतुरर्थाः,  the words ending in 'रोणी' get the 'अण्' प्रत्यय.
4.2.78.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

4.2.79.v: The affix अण् comes in the 4-fold sense after a stem having क् for its penultimate.

4.2.80.v: In the above 4-senses are added the following 17-affixes after the following 17 classes of words respectively - ……………………………………………….

4.2.81.v: The name of a kingdom is formed by the लुप् elision of these affixes (when the name of the people without the change of number and gender, is at the same time the name of the kingdom).

4.2.82.v: Also after the word वरण etc. the affix denoting locality becomes elided but the number and gender are not changed.

4.2.83.v: Optionally after the word शर्करा the 4-fold significant affix is elided by लुप् ।

4.2.84.v: The affixes ठक् and छ come after the word शर्करा in the 4-fold sense.

4.2.85.v: The affix मतुप् is added denoting a river.

4.2.86.v: The affix मतुप् is added to the words मधु etc. in the four senses given above.

4.2.87.v: The affix ड्मतुप् comes after the words 1. कुमुद 2. नड and 3. वेतस in the above four senses and the final of these words is elided before this affix.

4.2.88.v: The affix ड्वलच् comes after 1. नड and 2. शाद in the four senses given above, the final of the words being elided.

4.2.89.v: The affix वलच् comes after the word शिखा in the above four senses.

4.2.90.v: The affix छ comes after the words उत्कर etc. in the four senses.

4.2.91.v: The augment कुक् comes after the words नड etc. when the affix छ follows in the above four senses.

4.2.92.v: The affixes taught hereafter have senses other than those mentioned above.

4.2.93.v: The affixes घ and ख are respectively added after the words 1. राष्ट् and 2. अवारपार।

4.2.94.v: The affixes व and खञ् (ईन) come after the word ग्राम।

4.2.95.v: The affix ढकञ् (एयक) comes after the words कत्रि etc.

4.2.96.v: The affix ढकञ् is added to the words 1. कुल 2. कुक्षि and 3. ग्रीवा when the whole words so formed mean respectively 'a dog', 'a sword' and 'an ornament'.

4.2.97.v: The affix ढक् comes after the words नदी etc. in the remaining senses i.e. तत्र जातः [[4.3.25]] etc.

4.2.98.v: The words 1. दक्षिणा 2. पश्चात् and 3. पुरस् the affix त्यक् (त्य) is added in the remaining senses.

4.2.99.v: After the word कापिशी , the affix ष्फक् is added in the remaining senses (the feminine being formed by ङीष् -- षिद्गौरादिभ्यश्च [[4.1.41]]).

4.2.100.v: After the word रंकु the affixes ष्फक् and अण् are added in the remaining senses when the meaning is a non-human being.

4.2.101.v: After the words 1. दिव् 2. प्राच् 3. अपाच् 4. उदच् and 5. प्रत्यच् , the affix यत् is added in the remaining senses.

4.2.102.v: After the word कन्था the affix is ठक् is added in the remaining senses.

4.2.103.v: To the same stem is added the affix वुक् when it treats about something which is to be found in the land of वर्णु (name of a river and also the country near it).

4.2.104.v: The affix त्यप् comes after an indeclinable in the remaining senses.

4.2.105.v: The affix त्यप् is added optionally after the words 1. ऐषमस् 2. ह्यस् and 3. श्वस् , in the remaining senses.

4.2.106.v: The affix अञ् comes after a word ending with तीर and the ञ् comes after a word ending with कप्य , in the remaining senses.

4.2.107.v: The affix ञ comes in the remaining senses after a word preceded by another that signifies 'direction' provided the compound is not a name.

4.2.108.v: The affix अञ् is added to the word मद्र , preceded by a word denoting 'direction', in the remaining senses.

4.2.109.v: The affix अञ् comes in the remaining senses after a word consisting of more than two syllables having उदात्त accent on the final, being the name of a village of the people of the North.

4.2.110.v: The affix अण् comes in the remaining senses after a word ending with प्रस्थ after the words पलदी etc. and after a word having a penultimate क , whether these words express villages of North folk or not.

4.2.111.v: The affix अण् comes after the Patronymics formed from कण्व etc.

4.2.112.v: After a family-name formed by इञ् the affix अण् is added in the remaining senses.

4.2.113.v: The affix अण् is however not added to a word which though ending in the Patronymic affix इञ् consists of two syllables when it is the family name of Eastern People or of भरत।

4.2.114.v: After the word वृद्ध , the affix छ is added in the remaining senses.

4.2.115.v: The affixes ठक् and छस् come after वृद्ध word भवत् , in the remaining senses.

4.2.116.v: The affixes ठञ् and ञिठ् come in the remaining senses after the words काशि etc.

4.2.117.v: The affixes ठञ् and ञिठ् come in the remaining senses after the वृद्ध words denoting the villages of वाहीक।

4.2.118.v: The affixes ठञ् and ञिठ् come optionally in the remaining senses after the वृद्ध words denoting वाहीक villages situated in उशीनर।

4.2.119.v: The affixes ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) denoting a locality and ending in उ।

4.2.120.v: The affixes ठञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word ending in उ and denoting a locality of East-folks.

4.2.121.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting a locality which has the letter य as its penultimate and after a वृद्ध place name denoting a waste or desert place.

4.2.122.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting a locality and ending with 1. प्रस्थ 2. पुर or वह।

4.2.123.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting a locality of the East-folk, the word having penultimate र or ending in ई।

4.2.124.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting an inhabited kingdom or a limit of such kingdom

4.2.125.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses, even after a word which is not a वृद्ध which is always plural, when it denotes an inhabited country or a limit of such country, as well as after such वृद्ध words.

4.2.126.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after a word whether a वृद्ध or not, denoting a locality and having its second term the words 1. कच्छ 2. अग्नि 3. वक्त्र and 4. गर्त।

4.2.127.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after the words धूम etc. denoting country.

4.2.128.v: The affix वुञ् comes after the word नगर in the remaining senses, when censure or praise is implied.

4.2.129.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses after the word अरण्य , in the sense of 'a man'.

4.2.130.v: The affix वुञ् comes optionally in the remaining senses after the words 1. कुरु and 2. युगन्धर।

4.2.131.v: The affix कन् comes in the remaining senses after the words 1. मद्र and 2. वृजि।

4.2.132.v: The affix अण् comes in the remaining senses after a word denoting a place and having the letter क as its penultimate.

4.2.133.v: The affix अण् comes in the remaining senses after the words कच्छ etc. denoting places.

4.2.134.v: The affix वुञ् comes after the words कच्छ etc. in the senses of born etc. when the meaning is 'a man' or 'what exists in a man'.

4.2.135.v: The affix वुञ् comes after the word साल्व in the senses of being born etc. when denoting 'a man 'or 'what exists in a man', provided that it does not mean a foot-soldier.

4.2.136.v: The affix वुञ् comes in the remaining senses of being born etc. after the words साल्व etc. when the word signifies 'a cow' or 'a barley gruel'.

4.2.137.v: The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) denoting a place and having the word गर्त as its second term.

4.2.138.v: The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after the words गह etc.

4.2.139.v: The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after the words beginning with कद denoting the places of the East-folk.

4.2.140.v: The letter क is the substitute of the final of the word राजन् , when छ is added.

4.2.141.v: The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध word denoting a place and ending with अक् or इक् or having ख as its penultimate.

4.2.142.v: The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after a वृद्ध words, having the words 1. कन्था 2. पलद 3. नगर 4. ग्राम and 5. हृद , as second terms.

4.2.143.v: The affix छ comes after the word पर्वत in the remaining senses.

4.2.144.v: The affix छ optionally comes in the remaining senses after the word पर्वत when it does not denote 'a man'.

4.2.145.v: The affix छ comes in the remaining senses after कृकण and पर्ण when denoting the country भारद्वाच।
